tests.prompt: Call StartEncounter with no DungeonKey set (zero value). Verify it builds the same dungeon as an explicit DungeonKeyCrypt call -- the zero value falls back to the named default per #688's Scope ('a named default for now').

StartEncounter with the crypt key. Verify the persisted Space has exactly 3 regions tagged entrance/corridor/boss (RegionData.Archetype), Space.Theme == 'crypt', and the boss region's primary playable axis (min(width, height)) exceeds 6 hex steps.
StartEncounter with the crypt key. Verify every seated party member's spawn hex is tagged into the entrance-archetype region, and the first member spawns exactly at Space.Entrance.
Start two independent encounters with the same explicit RandomSeed and the crypt key. Verify their persisted Space.Walls (and Width/Height/Entrance) are byte-identical.
Call StartEncounter with a DungeonKey that has no registered spec. Verify it returns an error (ErrUnknownDungeonKey) and does not create or persist an encounter.

Start two encounters with the same key+seed but different party sizes (1 member vs 2 members). Verify the persisted dungeon geometry (Space.Walls/Width/Height/Regions/Entrance) is identical between them -- proving rpg-api passes the key/seed through verbatim and never varies geometry based on runtime request shape.

Run the full internal/orchestrators/lobby test package. Verify every pre-existing StartEncounter test not specific to two-chamber geometry (HP seeding, honest combat snapshot, stale action-economy clearing, arcade recovery, not-host/not-ready/already-started/not-found, persist-then-emit ordering) still passes unmodified.

White-box test the generalized entry-anchor helper against synthetic regions with arbitrary (non chamber-1/chamber-2) IDs. Verify it returns the door-neighbor hex tagged into the NAMED region, and errors when no matching neighbor exists.

StartEncounter with the crypt key. Verify goblinsPerRegion goblins are seeded into the entrance region and the boss (terminal) region, and zero goblins are seeded into the corridor region -- preserving the pre-#688 'both occupied endpoints' placement rule generalized by chain position, not by archetype-specific new seeding logic (rpg-api#689 stays out of scope).

Via the real LobbyService.StartEncounter + v1alpha2 EncounterService RPC surface (harness, real Redis container): party spawns at the entrance, a connector door projects DOOR_CLOSED with an id, sighting an entrance-region goblin starts a combat pocket excluding boss-region goblins from initiative, and boss-region goblins emit no EntityAppeared until both connector doors are opened and a sightline actually forms.

Review internal/orchestrators/lobby/start_encounter.go and any new dungeon-spec file: confirm every DungeonRegionParams/DungeonConnectorParams value is a literal constant or a direct pass-through of caller input (key, seed) -- no computed width/height/archetype based on lobby state, member count, or theme value.
